newsitem.title: UK: Transport Development says sector bleak. [CORRECTED 19:21 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Transport Development says sector bleak. [CORRECTED 19:21 GMT]

text.p: British plant and vehicle hire firm Transport Development Group Plc (TDG) said on Monday the company's (corrects from "country's") hire operations sector is still experiencing a difficult trading environment (corrects from "having a difficult time") but still saw opportunities for longer term growth.
After a meeting with investment analysts on Monday, TDG said it would continue to grow in the plant hire sector by expanding its geographic coverage and increasing its fleet utilisation.

In a statement, the company said it would also improve returns from its vehicle hire business by improving fleet management and increasing the proportion of the fleet subject to contract hire agreements.
The statement did not give details of the expansion plans. TDG had reported operating profits of 2.9 million stg on a turnover of 23.8 million stg for the six months ended June 30, 1996.
